# clerk_organization_role (Resource)

Manages a Clerk organization role.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "clerk_organization_role" "editor" {
  name        = "Editor"
  key         = "org:editor"
  description = "Can edit content within the organization"
  permissions = [clerk_organization_permission.create_posts.id]
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `key` (String) Unique key for the role (e.g. org:editor).
- `name` (String) Display name of the role.

### Optional

- `description` (String) Description of the role.
- `permissions` (List of String) List of permission IDs to assign to this role.

### Read-Only

- `created_at` (String) Timestamp when the role was created.
- `id` (String) Unique identifier of the organization role.
- `is_creator_eligible` (Boolean) Whether the role is eligible to be assigned to organization creators.
- `updated_at` (String) Timestamp when the role was last updated.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
terraform import clerk_organization_role.example <organization_role_id>
```
